idle.evidence: Same body/feet bounds in all six cells; gradual eyelid closing then reopen; wing posture held throughout. Native eyes and robe contours legible. Wing width +15px from wider resting pose, character height and feet baseline preserved.

running.evidence: Hand stays attached near chin through all six frames; lids narrow and reopen. No alternation between temple gesture and chin gesture. All six cells share identical bbox and feet baseline.

standard_transitions.evidence: Idle and retained jumping resting baseline same (bottom at y203 exclusive); airborne frame visibly lifts and returns. Broader idle wings remain distinct pose rather than body scale jump; head and trunk size consistent across retained states.

directions.evidence: Whole sixteen-pose family registered at stable ground line. Cardinal chin/gaze orientations clearly up/right/down/left; two loop boundaries retain planted body and expected clockwise gaze.

limits: Comparison reports measure sprite artwork continuity; app render frame rate and Retina display interpolation cannot be changed through the Pets asset API.
